body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: cut**

Every term restates the two definitions below it: ROW_ELEMS_32 = LINE_BYTES_64 / sizeof(bf16) and ROW_DWORDS_16 = LINE_BYTES_64 / DWORD_BYTES_4 already say a row is one line, 32 bf16 and 16 dwords. The header (line 26) already defines a pair row as one 64-byte line.

Proposed: cut the comment.
